description.en: NVIDIA 600M streaming ASR model for low-latency and batch transcription across 40 language-locales, with native punctuation, capitalization, automatic language detection, and configurable chunk sizes.
description.zh: NVIDIA 600M 流式 ASR 模型，面向 40 种语言区域的低延迟与批量转写，具备原生标点、大小写、自动语言检测与可配置分块大小。

language.en: ASR prompt language such as en-US, da-DK, or auto; default is the model's default prompt.
language.zh: ASR 提示语言，例如 en-US、da-DK 或 auto； default 是模型的默认提示。

max_tokens.en: Maximum RNNT generated tokens; 0 or omitted uses the model-derived limit.
max_tokens.zh: RNNT 生成代币的最大数量； 0 或省略使用模型导出的限制。

lookahead_tokens.en: Chunk-limited encoder right context in 80 ms frames; supported values and the default come from processor_config (0, 3, 6 or 13; default 3 for the published model). In masked speaker mode, omission derives lookahead from diarizer geometry (13 fallback).
lookahead_tokens.zh: 以 80 ms 帧计的受限编码器右上下文；支持值与默认值来自 processor_config（0、3、6 或 13；发布模型默认 3）。masked speaker 模式下，省略时按 diarizer 几何推导 lookahead（回退 13）。

keep_language_tags.en: Keep language tag tokens in decoded text; default false.
keep_language_tags.zh: 在解码文本中保留语言标签 token；默认 false。

return_timestamps.en: Compatibility/advisory flag; false does not suppress decoder token timestamps.
return_timestamps.zh: 兼容/提示标志；false 不会抑制解码器 token 时间戳。

streaming.en: Request a streaming run; must be false for offline sessions.
streaming.zh: 请求流式运行；离线会话必须为 false。

speaker_probabilities.en: nemotron_3_diar speaker_probabilities.safetensors for the same audio (diarize with return_frame_probabilities=true). Setting it enables speaker-tagged output: speaker turns with text and a SegLST artifact.
speaker_probabilities.zh: 同一音频的 nemotron_3_diar speaker_probabilities.safetensors（使用 return_frame_probabilities=true 进行 diarize）。设置后启用带说话人标签的输出：说话人轮次、文本与 SegLST 产物。

speaker_mode.en: masked runs one ASR stream per active speaker on speaker-masked features (NeMo masked multitalker ASR) and transcribes overlapping speech; attribution assigns each word of one transcript to the most active speaker and is cheaper.
speaker_mode.zh: masked 模式在说话人遮罩特征上为每个活跃说话人运行一条 ASR 流（NeMo masked multitalker ASR），可转写重叠语音；attribution 将单条转写的每个词归给最活跃说话人，开销更低。

speaker_mask.en: Masked mode only: mask log-mel features (NeMo mask_features) or zero the waveform of inactive 80 ms frames.
speaker_mask.zh: 仅 masked 模式：遮罩 log-mel 特征（NeMo mask_features）或将非活跃 80 ms 帧的波形置零。

speaker_segment_gap_sec.en: Start a new segment for a speaker after a pause longer than this; default 1.0 (NeMo sent_break_sec).
speaker_segment_gap_sec.zh: 说话人停顿超过该值时开始新片段；默认 1.0（NeMo sent_break_sec）。

speaker_segment_max_sec.en: Streaming only: force-close a speaker-turn event after this many seconds; the final result keeps the full segments. Default 10. Must be positive.
speaker_segment_max_sec.zh: 仅流式：超过该秒数后强制关闭说话人轮次事件；最终结果保留完整片段。默认 10，必须为正。
